title: Reduced integral pullback tensor composition equation
statement:
theorem integralPullbackTensorCompositionReduced {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [hZ : ∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) :
    (integralSystemReduction l E Z).map
        (((@canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l _ E _ _ _ Z Y (h ≫ f) hZ hY) M N).hom ≫
          ((@constructibleIntegralTensor l _ E _ _ _ Z hZ)).map (Prod.mkHom
            (((@pullbackTensorIntegralComposition l _ E _ _ _ X Y Z f h hX hY hZ)).hom.app M)
            (((@pullbackTensorIntegralComposition l _ E _ _ _ X Y Z f h hX hY hZ)).hom.app N))) =
      (integralSystemReduction l E Z).map
        (((@pullbackTensorIntegralComposition l _ E _ _ _ X Y Z f h hX hY hZ)).hom.app
          (((@constructibleIntegralTensor l _ E _ _ _ Y hY)).obj (M, N)) ≫
          ((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ Z X h hZ hX)).map
            ((@canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY) M N).hom ≫
          ((@canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l _ E _ _ _ Z X h hZ hX)
            (((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).obj M)
            (((@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ X Y f hX hY)).obj N)).hom)

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941; quotient-tower reduction of the pullback/tensor composition square.

proof.text: OPEN OBLIGATION: choose simultaneous flat-term K-flat representatives and their strict quotient systems. Before localization, use the adjunction-normalized pullback compositor; the two tensor-composition paths have the same pure-tensor formula and commute with every quotient transition. The completed quotient realization provides the comparison and the coherent counit transport. The recorded integral compositor (pullbackTensorIntegralComposition, chosen from integralPullbackComposition, whose predicate fixes only finite reductions and associativity) must be identified with this strict compositor on whole representatives: its finite reductions alone do not determine it (Milnor lim^1 kernel). Expose or strengthen that normalization, then localize the single strict-system equality, conjugate by the prescribed reduction comparisons, and cancel the invertible target comparison. The previous proof by joint faithfulness of finite evaluations was invalid and is withdrawn.
